interview.secured: Day secured means I've completed my daily challenge and confirmed it, so my streak is protected for today.
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is during the screens I saw.
interview.selfReported: Self-reported means I manually logged the task myself rather than it being automatically tracked.
interview.tomorrow: 8 - The streak tracking and daily check-in system feels motivating, even at 3am after a long shift.

goals.text: Finish onboarding and one task with as few decisions as possible, until the app says the day is secured.
